name: Band Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends beside your thighs with straight arms.
Unlock your knees slightly, pull your shoulders back, and brace your core with a flat spine.
Hinge smoothly back at your hips until you feel a clear hamstring stretch without rounding your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to drive your hips forward and stand tall against the band.
tips: Keep your slight knee bend steady throughout the hinge rather than turning it into a squat.
Stop hinging as soon as your lower back begins to round.
